AST-01.name: Ian Tormod Cameron
record_text: AST-01 — Ian Tormod Cameron of Lochaber
Identity: Player characterDate of birth: 5 May 1398Age: 17Height: 6'2" / approximately 188 cmOrigin: Lochaber, ScotlandCurrent location: Lord Camoys's Southampton lodging
Physical appearance

Exceptionally tall, broad-shouldered, stocky and well-conditioned. His face is based on the user's approved photographic likeness, adapted to seventeen years of age. Dark hair and established Cameron-associated clothing and equipment remain identifying features.
Background
Only child of Captain Eoghan Cameron and Aoife Cameron. Raised on the Cameron family property, with experience in agriculture, hunting, horses, weapon practice and practical physical work.
His mother taught him literacy and domestic knowledge; his father provided much of his martial education.
He travelled south with the Welsh timber merchant Emrys Lloyd.
Established abilities
Practiced swordsmanship and shield handling.
Competent archery with a Welsh longbow.
Extensive familiarity with Abel and his trained commands.
Practical hunting, rural work, fieldcraft and masonry.
Literacy and knowledge of Gaelic, English and Latin.
Strong physical conditioning and unusual stature.
His demonstrated ability in a practice bout does not establish superiority over every professional combatant.
Equipment and possessions
Ancestral Chronicle Blade.
Original wooden heater shield and detachable Cameron heraldic leather.
Layered leather-and-mail armour.
Helmet combining leather, mail and steel components.
Leg protection and plated boots.
Welsh longbow and associated equipment.
Personal clothing, travel tools and writing materials.
Abel, his horse.
Unsuitable saddle currently stored by Oswin.
The Coopian Shield remains an approved design draft rather than completed equipment.
Current condition
Right palm remains injured. Hugh Atwood cleaned and redressed it on Day 2 without charging Ian.
Military status
Sir Richard Wycliffe has accepted him personally as a prospective squire and agreed to sponsor and instruct him.
Formal appointment, authorization, wages, maintenance arrangements and muster status remain unresolved.
Relationships
Son of Aoife and Eoghan Cameron.
Owner and familiar handler of Abel.
Prospective squire of Richard Wycliffe.
Acquainted with Fletcher, Harker, Bell and Reed.
Developing a mutually welcomed personal relationship with Ælfflæd Blackwell.
Latest confirmed event

Returned from evening leave, visited Abel, obtained supervised access to the household writing room, used his own parchment offcut for personal notes and translations, and retired to the shared lodging at approximately 9:45 PM. At the chapter boundary Matthew extinguished the light and Ian is asleep; no Day 3 wake-up action is established.
A longer letter to his parents remains unfinished and unsent.
Player agency restriction
No dialogue, thoughts, motives, movements, expenditure, promises or future decisions may be created for Ian outside his declarations or verified gameplay.
Visual reference (approved): Highlander Character Concept Sheet.png (latest 37-sheet archive).

AST-04.name: Abel
record_text: AST-04 — Abel
Species: HorseSex: MaleAge: Approximately ten yearsOwner: Ian CameronCurrent care: Oswin Tanner, Southampton stables
Appearance
Large, powerful Highland-type stallion. Auburn-brown base coat, irregular black and white markings, dark mane and tail, and substantial lower-leg feathering.
His approved concept sheet governs his recognizable coat pattern and proportions.
Parentage
Sire: Ascalon, Eoghan Cameron's former warhorse.
Dam: Established Highland mare; name not confirmed.
Established history
Worked on the Cameron property and travelled south with Ian.
He responds to familiar commands and has demonstrated trained behaviours, including controlled waiting, following, fetching and carefully directed interaction.
Current equipment
Ian's existing saddle has been examined and declared unsuitable for riding pending further assessment.
Oswin currently holds that saddle in storage. Ownership remains Ian's.
Military preparation
Richard agreed to assist with gradual preparation for possible military service.
Abel's suitability for battlefield conditions remains unproven. Mounted exercises must await safe tack.

Stable condition: At the end of Day 2 Abel had been fed, watered and settled; a temporary stall-catch securing arrangement was in place because of his ability to manipulate the catch. Permanent replacement remained outstanding.
Identity correction
Abel is the canonical name. Able is an obsolete spelling.
Visual reference (approved): Able_ Highland Warhorse Concept Sheet.png (latest 37-sheet archive).
B. RECRUITMENT AND MILITARY ASSOCIATES

Established relationship with Ian
Ian visited her on both campaign days.
During the second evening she willingly returned his handclasp, expressed pleasure in his company and invited him to visit again when his duties permitted.
Ian taught her the Gaelic expression “Tapadh leat.”
Their personal bond has developed, but no betrothal, formal courtship or binding future arrangement exists.

Latest status: At the Blackwell household following Ian's departure. During the second visit Ian and Ælfflæd shared supper, Gaelic expressions, affectionate handholding and a hand kiss; she wished to know him better before a kiss on the lips. She mentioned that she might inquire at the household gate with family permission; no visit, message to the porters, or future appointment has been arranged.
